meta.title: Hakili Dayɛlin — Bamanankan kuma kɔrɔw ni Manden dɔnniya
meta.description: Bamanankan kuma kɔrɔw, Manden tɔgɔ, laadala, tariku ni kalan: Afiriki tilebin, Manden mansaya.

hero.title: Kan bɛ miiri cogo ni ɲɛnamaya cogo ta
hero.intro: Nin kuma kɔrɔw bɛ yɛlɛn ka bɔ mɔgɔ kɔrɔw ma ka taa mɔgɔ kuraw ma. Hakilitigi belebelew ye u dabɔ.

questions.title: Ɲininkali looru ka faamu
questions.intro: Kan fɔ, kan kalan ni a lakana ye hakili cogo, kuma cogo ni ɲɛnamaya cogo mara ye.

identity.label: Mɔgɔ yɛrɛ
identity.a1: Manden ye Afiriki tilebin laadala yɔrɔ ye, Mali, Gine, Kodiwari, Senegali ni Burukina Faso fan fɛ. Kan ɲɔgɔn-dɔw bɛ fɔ yen: Bamanankan, Jula, Maninkakan, Malinke, Mandinka ni Susu.
identity.a2: I ka kan fɔ ye i yɛrɛ fɔ ye: foli, maana fɔ ni i ka yɔrɔ dɔn denbaya ni jamana kɔnɔ, o bɛɛ bɛ tɛmɛ kumaw fɛ.

culture.label: Laadala
culture.q: Mɔgɔw bɛ ɲɛnamaya cogo di Sahɛli la bɔgɔ ka so kɔnɔ, minnu bɛ tɛmɛ san kɛmɛ caman kan?
culture.a1: Bɔgɔ ye dugukolo ye min bɛ kɛ so kɛli la. A bɛ bɛn Sahɛli ka waati ma.
culture.a2: Jenɛ la, dugu mɔgɔw bɛ Misiri belebele kuraya san o san. Baarakɛ dɔnniya bɛ tɛmɛ ka bɔ ɲɛmɔgɔ la ka taa kalandenw ma.

complex.label: Yɛrɛ dɔgɔya
complex.q: Mun na Afiriki dɔnniya caman jatera dɔgɔ ye?
complex.a1: Tubabu ka mara waati la, olu ye kuma ɲɛ dɔnniya jate dɔgɔ ye ka tɛmɛ sɛbɛnni dɔnniya kan. O bɛ se ka yɛrɛ dɔgɔya lase mɔgɔw ma.
complex.a2: I ka kan ni i ka kuma kɔrɔw jate hakili ɲɛ yɔrɔ ye, o bɛ yɛrɛ jate segin i ma, k'a sɔrɔ i ma diɲɛ dɔnniya tɔw dɔgɔya.

history.label: Tariku
history.q: Manden mansaya tariku bɛ mun fɔ?
history.a1: San kɛmɛ tan ni saba la, Sunjata Keyita ye Mali mansaya da. Kurukan Fuga sariya tɛmɛna da fɛ. A fɔra ko a ye ɲɔgɔn fɛ ɲɛnamaya sira dɔ sigi.
history.a2: Jeliw bɛ siyaw ni maanaw mara. Olu ye nin tariku ka hakili ɲɛnama ye, sɛbɛnni kɔrɔw kɛrɛ fɛ.

education.label: Kalan
education.q: U tun bɛ sankolo lajɛli, jatew ni fɛn caman kalan cogo di ni masinw tun tɛ yen?
education.a1: U tun bɛ kalan ni lajɛli, hakili ni dɔnniya di ye: ɲɛmɔgɔ tun bɛ a di kalanden ma. Sankolo tun bɛ sɛnɛ waati jira. Nɛgɛ dagali ni bɔgɔlanfini kɛli bɛ shimi dɔnniya jira.
education.a2: Tinbuktu la, sɛbɛn ba caman bɛ yen Arabukan ni jamanakan na, minnu bɛ dɔnniya, sariya ni diinɛ kuma. Nin kalan laadala sɛbɛnnen bɛ yen, nka a dɔ ka kan ka lajɛ hali bi.

contact.title: Sɛbɛn an ye
contact.intro: Hakili, laadilikan walima kuma kɔrɔ min bɛ i fɛ, a ci yan.
contact.name: I tɔgɔ
contact.error: A ma ci. I ka internɛti lajɛ ka segin.

travel.title: Manden taamara yɔrɔ jumɛnw la?
travel.intro: Manden ma to a bɔyɔrɔ la. Nin ye taamashyɛnw ye, ni u dan ye.
travel.mapLabel: Misali, a tɛ bɛn jate ma: yɔrɔ looru min bɛ Manden ni ɲɔgɔn ye, ka bɔ Manden na ka taa Boriku ni Kano la.
travel.mapNote: Misali dɔrɔn, a tɛ jate kɔrɔ ye.

manden.text: Mali mansaya bɔyɔrɔ, san kɛmɛ tan ni saba la.

kaabu.text: Kaabu tun ye Manden mansaw ka jɛkulu ye. Tiramakan Tarawele, Sunjata ka kɛlɛcɛ, ye a da. A kɛra yɛrɛmara ye Mali kɔ, san 1537 jate, a binna Kansala la san 1867.

sierra.text: Mandekan caman bɛ fɔ yen (Mende, Kono, Kurankɔ, Susu). U ni Mali mansaya ɲɔgɔn bɛ cogo min na, o ma dɔn kosɛbɛ.

kano.text: Wangara julaw, Manden bɔbagaw, ye silamɛya lase Kano ma, Kano tariku sɛbɛn ye a fɔ ten. A kɛra san 1349-1385 walima san 1463-1499.

borgou.text: Boko/Busa bɛ Mandekan dɔ fɔ yen, ani Wangara jamaw bɛ yen fana. Nin ye jago, diinɛ ni kan ye, a tɛ kɛlɛ sɔrɔli ye.

travel.caveat: Manden ni Mali mansaya tɛ kelen ye: Mandekan siyaw ka kɔrɔ ka tɛmɛ mansaya kan.
travel.sources: A lajɛ: Kaabu ko sɛbɛnw, Kano tariku sɛbɛn, ani Brégand ka « Les Wangara du Borgou ».
